migration_notes: Mobile template gained a themed structure: constants/theme.ts color tokens (light/dark, read via useColors()), hooks/ (use-colors, use-color-scheme), a queries/ folder of data hooks, and a default app/(tabs)/ navigator. app.json now uses userInterfaceStyle: "automatic" and tsconfig adds the @/* path alias. Existing apps can keep their current layout; adopt the pieces they need.
Web queries/ files now export data hooks (useX wrapping useQuery/useMutation) instead of bare *Query option factories; components call the hook directly.

Web static assets (images, videos, fonts, audio) must live in packages/web/public/ and be referenced by absolute URL path (e.g. /images/hero.png); lint now rejects asset files and asset imports under packages/web/src/. Move any existing assets into public/ and update references.

New template Vite plugin vite/__plugins/asset-optimizer-plugin.ts optimizes all images and videos in the build output (sequential, cached, low resource usage; videos transcode via system ffmpeg when available, otherwise the build warns above 10MB); it must stay imported in vite.config.ts. packages/web gains a sharp devDependency.

The design brief now lives in a single design.md at the app root covering web, mobile, and desktop (packages/mobile/design.md was removed). The db:studio script was removed — query the database directly instead.

Service ports now have a single source of truth: the template-managed __ports.cjs (web 4200, mobile 4300, desktop 4400). Both Vite configs import it and set strictPort, so a dev server can no longer drift onto a different port when the assigned one is busy — it fails loudly instead. ecosystem.config.cjs and the kill:port and dev:mobile scripts read the same file; PORT is no longer honoured as an override.

Dev commands no longer accept a custom port. Start services with bun run dev, dev:mobile, or dev:desktop, and free a busy port with bun run kill:port instead of moving the service — the preview URL is derived from the fixed port.
runtime_checks: The web preview starts on port 4200 and survives a restart on the same port.

migration_notes: The template build script moved out of the app. .runable/build-template.ts and .runable/releases.schema.ts are gone, and with them the zod, semver, and @types/semver devDependencies they were the only users of. Existing apps can delete both files and those three dependencies.
.runable/releases.json, .runable/protected-files.json, and .template-version stay in the app. The platform regenerates the derived two.

Lint tooling moved into the @runablehq/runkit devDependency. konsistent.json and __lint-rules/ were deleted from the app, and .oxlintrc.json is now a stub that extends the shared config. The konsistent and oxlint devDependencies were replaced by runkit, which pins both.

Keep both keys in .oxlintrc.json. oxlint resolves overrides.files against the config doing the extending, so the shared globs only match from the app root, and ignorePatterns does not inherit through extends. Point extends at ./node_modules/@runablehq/runkit/oxlintrc.json: oxlint reads extends as a path, not a package specifier.

bun run lint and lint:fix now call runkit. The internal:check-conventions script was removed, so run bun run lint instead. packages/web also lost its per-package lint script — the root bun run lint is the only entry point the skills and the shared config expect.

The mobile-layout-keeps-template-providers convention now expects ../components/__ErrorBoundary, matching the rename in 0.3.x. Apps still importing ../components/ErrorBoundary should update the import.

@runablehq/runkit moves to 0.1.1, which fixes bun run lint inside a sandbox. oxlint reserves 128 GiB of address space to load JS plugins, a 4 GB sandbox refuses the mapping, and oxlint panics rather than falling back, so the lint step has never completed there. runkit no longer uses oxlint plugins at all.

The asset-imports and protected-files rules are unchanged in what they reject, but they now run as a runkit stage rather than as oxlint rules, so their output is no longer in oxlint's format and they report before oxlint runs. Nothing in the app's .oxlintrc.json changes.
Apps only need to bump the @runablehq/runkit devDependency and run bun install.

__ports.cjs re-exports .runable/ports.json instead of declaring the numbers itself. Every consumer still reads __ports.cjs and the ports an app runs on do not change, but the file holding them is now data Runable writes when it creates the app rather than a constant baked into the template.
Runable assigns each app its own ports so two apps can run side by side in one sandbox. An app keeps the ports it was created with for its lifetime, because its preview URLs are derived from them.
Apps taking this release must add .runable/ports.json holding their current website, mobile and desktop ports before replacing __ports.cjs, or every consumer of the file fails to resolve it.
